posts.text: The HDFC Defence Fund (Direct - Growth) -is the only indian pure equity fund which has given excellent return over 1 year and 3 year period - it signals the success of Govt’s Atma nirbhar bharat in defence expenditure. Started in 2023 , it is the largest actively managed defence sector thematic scheme in India, currently commanding an Asset Under Management (AUM) of ₹11,477 Crore . As of September 2026 , the fund has posted an impressive 1-year trailing return of 35.80% , outperforming its standard category benchmark.
